autoResolved.choice: Whether Engine gaining a new outgoing ProjectReference to Boundaries (AgentGuard.Engine -> AgentGuard.Boundaries) is a forbidden backwards/inverted assembly dependency requiring Tim's personal sign-off under best-practices-guide.md 2d.
autoResolved.resolution: Not backwards, and no separate sign-off is needed beyond the relocation approval Tim already gave. Principle 2d forbids a LOWER, depended-upon assembly having a service injected INTO it from a HIGHER assembly that depends on it. Here nothing is injected into Boundaries: Boundaries keeps its own four adapters unchanged and stays exactly as depended-upon as before (its two internal-access grants simply swap from {guard, AgentGuard.TestHelpers} to {AgentGuard.Engine}); Engine — the higher, consuming assembly — merely gains a new outgoing edge to Boundaries, running in the same direction Cli's existing direct Boundaries reference already runs today. No service flows from Engine down into Boundaries in either direction.
